rationale: All three FCIs (n1, n2, n4) observed fault current. FCI n4 seeing current requires the fault to be at or downstream of n4 via section s24. The only downstream candidate is s45 (n4->n5). A fault on s45 is upstream of no other FCI and outages only downstream customer n5, which matches the sole outage complaint (n5). Other sections yield FCI mismatches (e.g., s24 would not trip fci_n4; s23/s12/s01 would not trip downstream FCIs).
